text: Babe, keep looking at me like that and you're coming upstairs. Say less. I'm already parked. Easy, tiger. Text me first. Wait. What perfume are you wearing? My car still smells like you. I'm actually obsessed. Girl, I just left his car. He's already obsessed. Okay, what did you wear? Let me smell. Noir and Aura by One Memory. My little date night combo. Girl, send the link. Right now. Both come in one set. Tap the orange cart. Thank me later.
